narrative.overview: Ze is one mind writing to one world-state, and the interface is the instrument panel that shows that state: hairline frames with bracketed corners on a plum field, a purple key light, letter-spaced labels beside thin numerals, dot-matrix display type, and a dotted sphere that breathes while Ze listens and flares coral when something slips. Light carries depth, never shadows. Motion is continuous. Every line, dot and tone encodes what Ze knows, how sure it is, and what it is doing about it.
keyCharacteristics: Purple-led; Orchid default, Ultraviolet and Amethyst alternates
Four brightness levels: cream, orchid, dim, faint
Hairline frames with bracketed corners; zero radius
Dot-matrix display, Michroma labels, Saira body, JetBrains Mono readouts
Honesty visuals on every claim: filled told, half inferred, dashed suspected, hollow goal, coral slipped, dotted decay trail
The orb is the presence: nine states, spring morphs, a shared heartbeat

rules.name: The One Alarm Rule
rules.body: Coral means slipped. Gates, suspicions and confirmations are cream.

rules.name: The Four Levels Rule
rules.body: Every text element sits on cream, orchid, dim or faint. No fifth level.

rules.name: The Light Rule
rules.body: Depth is light on a surface, never a shadow under it.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on numbers, times, ids and deltas.

rules.name: The Px-True Chart Type Rule
rules.body: Chart text is sized by viewBox units per CSS pixel so it is the same size at every width.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; light appears on hover, focus and activity.

dos: Do keep every claim's posture visible and consistent across chart, rows and cards.
Do make hover and focus visible as light on the frame.
Do render module labels as h2, keep 44px targets, and theme caret, selection, scrollbars and focus rings.
Do print numbers in tabular mono and show the value beside any meter.
donts: Don't use coral for selection, emphasis, gates or confirmations.
Don't add drop shadows, backdrop blur, rounded corners or flat lavender fills.
Don't cut or crossfade the orb between states.
Don't show raw enums, tracebacks or prototype asides to the user.
Don't add a second accent, a kicker above a heading, or a cinematic register.
